messages:
olivia: Quick update / triage thread: noticed a cluster-wide p99 uplift when continuous-batching + kv-prefetch are enabled on canary-2. p99s jumped from ~800ms to ~3.8s after last night's kernel-v3 roll. anyone on-call for kernel or kv?
sam: I'm on it. Pulling traces now. Dashboards show grpc inflight spikes and a surge in kv cache evictions at the same time window.
jia: I ran a focused repro with batch=64 seq=512 against the canary image and saw lots of `prefetch worker` goroutine restarts. Sharing a short script: `./tools/mini_bench --model=gpt-small --batch=64 --seq=512 --kv=prefetch`
mike: saw this log line too: ```WARN kv: prefetch cancelled while inflight=true at prefetch_manager.go:142``` Looks like cancel + close order issue.
ravi_s: Assign owners and quick plan? We should avoid broad toggles if we can rollout more surgically.
olivia: Ownership proposal: kernel owner = @mike (investigate close/race), kv owner = @jia (prefetch worker lifecycle), infra/queue = @sam (watch grpc/backpressure, adjust queue thresholds). Agree?
sam: Agree. I'll also add a short-term alert: grpc_inflight > 200 for >1m to #eng-runtime-alerts and enable bench-bot to run a 15m load every hour on canary.
bench-bot: scheduled bench: canary-2, batch=64, seq=512, kv=prefetch -> started
jia: I opened a draft PR with extra instrumentation + a deterministic unit that simulates concurrent cancel+close: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/963 — need review and perf signoff.
mike: I'll pick up the race fix. Plan: add an idempotent Close + Abort ordering fix and add a metrics counter for cancelled prefetches. I'll ping @ravi_s for design review.
olivia: Cool. Can we agree on milestone targets for the sprint? Suggested: 1) stabilize prefetch (no p99 >1s on canary) 2) add perf regression test in CI (bench harness) 3) dashboard/alerts tuned. Two-day quick sprint?
jia: Two days seems tight but doable for a hotfix + bench. Perf test in CI might be lightweight (sanity bench) then separate nightly for full perf.
mike: Agree on hotfix first. I'll open PR with fix + unit. Then we run bench-bot across canary fleet: 10% ramp -> 50% -> 100% for software toggle testing.
sam: I'll prepare a canary rollout plan in infra: start with 5% traffic toggle enabling prefetch on a subset, monitor grpc_inflight and kv_miss_rate, then proceed if stable.
olivia: Communication plan: notify supportive teams (support, product) if we need to rollback. I'll draft a short note for #all-hands if we escalate.
jia: After fix we should add a regression test that runs `prefetch` path under concurrency in CI as a gomaxprocs=1 deterministic run to catch ordering issues.
mike: Will also run extended bench for 2 hours to get tail percentiles. Posting results here once done.
eng-sre: Looping in eng-sre for possible grpc QPS throttling knobs and queue tuning. We can pre-provision a temporary increase in queue depth if needed during the investigation.
olivia: Action items recap: mike -> implement fix + push PR; jia -> add perf instrumentation + regression test; sam -> canary rollout plan + alerts; eng-sre -> advise on grpc queue tuning; bench-bot -> run hourly benches and post results. Sync tomorrow 09:30am PT if unresolved. :white_check_mark:
bench-bot: bench completed: p50=95ms p95=260ms p99=720ms (prefetch disabled), bench with prefetch on canary-2 aborted due to worker restart; logs attached.
mike: Thanks — I'll prioritize the race fix and aim to have an RFC PR + hotfix within 4 hours.
olivia: Thanks team. Keep updates in-thread and add brief notes on PRs. If anyone needs pairing time ping me."
